quest.kingdomomnitrix.awakening.title: The Awakening
quest.kingdomomnitrix.awakening.offer.1: Darkness is seeping into this world. At night rifts open, and the Heartless crawl out of them.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.awakening.offer.2: Face them. Defeat five Heartless and show me your heart is strong enough.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.awakening.progress: The rifts appear at night. Keep your Keyblade ready.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.awakening.complete: Well done. Your light is stronger than you think.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.keyblade_forge.off: A Keyblade grows with its wielder. For that you need a Keyblade Forge.
Build one and bring me eight gold ingots for the first refinement.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.keyblade_forge.pro: The forge needs gold, iron, an anvil and a heart.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.keyblade_forge.com: Take this crystal. It will strengthen your fire.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.omnitrix.title: A Watch from Space
quest.kingdomomnitrix.omnitrix.offer.1: Ben never thought a watch would change his life. Maybe it changes yours.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.omnitrix.offer.2: A Plumber cruiser went down tonight. If it carried what I think, you'll find the parts of an Omnitrix on board.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.omnitrix.progress: Shell and console from the wreck, an energy core, an Omnitrix Workbench with four stabilizers – the Corrodium for it is only in the End.
Heatblast! Right-click the sample, then G – and mind the hedge.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.terminal.title: Bolts and Blasters
quest.kingdomomnitrix.terminal.offer.1: Without a weapon terminal I can't get you any gear.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.terminal.offer.2: Craft one. I'll put some bolts on your account as starting money.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.terminal.progress: Iron, glass, redstone and a diamond.
Excellent. The Combuster is already on offer.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heli_pack.title: Lift-Off
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heli_pack.offer.1: I have plans for a Heli-Pack. It breaks any fall – and turns into a Heli-Jet on demand.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heli_pack.offer.2: Build it and bring me eight feathers for the next model's rotor blades.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heli_pack.progress: Right-click puts the Heli-Pack into your gadget belt (H).
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heli_pack.complete: Here, chain and hook – enough for a Swingshot.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.zombie_bounty.offe: The zombies are making the campsite unsafe.
Take out ten and bring me sixteen rotten flesh as proof. The bounty pays every time.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heartless_hunt.off: Stronger Heartless gather in the rifts: Soldiers and Large Bodies.
Defeat three Soldiers and one Large Body. You can only hurt the Large Body from behind.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heartless_hunt.pro: Large Bodies only come out of the heavy rifts from level 6.
quest.kingdomomnitrix.heartless_hunt.com: An ice crystal for your trouble. The hunt continues whenever you like.
npc.kingdomomnitrix.yen_sid.greeting.2: The darkness does not wait. What brings you to me?

npc.kingdomomnitrix.clank.farewell: See you soon. And remember: a wrench does not solve every problem. But many.

screen.kingdomomnitrix.loadout.one_ultim: Only one Ultimate can be equipped.
message.kingdomomnitrix.no_ground: No solid ground to tear up.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ground_slam.desc: Hold to charge, release to drive all four fists into the ground: a growing shockwave, flying earth and a real crater that widens with the charge.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.throw.desc: Grabs the target and hurls it — it crashes into everything it hits. Too big to lift: a wrestling slam into the ground. No target: tears a boulder out of the ground and throws it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.titan_leap.desc: A huge bound forward. The landing strikes with a shockwave and crater that grow with the fall height.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.thunder_clap.des: Claps his huge hands together — a cone of pressure ahead, enemies fly and are dazed.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.iron_skin.desc: Tenses every muscle: much less damage, no knockback, double rage from hits taken and part of melee damage is thrown back.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.earthquake.desc: Ultimate: pounds the ground again and again — several ever larger shockwaves while fissures tear the ground open in a star shape.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.four_fist_barrag: Eight blows in rapid succession, two fists at a time, holding enemies in place. The last blow uses all four and sends them flying through walls.
Launches the target straight up, leaps after it and smashes it back into the ground. Without a target the uppercut breaks through the ceiling.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slab_heave.desc: Tears a row of ground blocks out and hurls them as a fan, like Four Arms throwing pieces of road in the show. Every chunk strikes with a crater.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.giant_swing.desc: Grabs the nearest enemy and whirls it around twice — everyone in the circle gets hit by it — then throws it where you are looking.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.war_cry.desc: A Tetramand battle roar: fills your rage, weakens enemies and makes them attack you instead of your party. Nearby party members gain strength.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.titan_meteor.des: Ultimate: shoots straight into the sky and dives onto the point you are looking at. Huge crater, shockwave ring and fissures in every direction.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shoulder_ram.des: Combo: hit while sprinting. Shoulder first — the target flies far and crashes into whatever it hits.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.hammer_fist.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. All four fists from above drive the target into the ground.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.grapple_toss.des: Combo: hit while sneaking. Grabs the target and throws it behind you in a high arc onto the ground.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.meteor_fist.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Dives down fists first; the impact grows with the height.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.quad_finisher.de: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. All four fists locked overhead strike down — extra damage based on missing health, crater and shockwave.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.tetramand_rage.d: Rage builds from damage dealt and even more from damage taken. From half: harder blows. When full: rampage — your next ability uses the rage for its biggest form.
Four melee hits in quick succession: the fourth strikes with all four fists for extra damage, wide knockback and a ground impact.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.tetramand_hide.d: Thick red hide: 30% less damage from projectiles, 25% less from explosions and 12% less from everything else.
screen.kingdomomnitrix.loadout.help_shor: Click an ability, then a key slot. Right-click a slot: default.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.flamethrower.des: A 1.5-second stream of fire from both hands: hits everything in the cone several times and sets the ground alight.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.blaze_roll.desc: A short dash as a burning wheel: untouchable while rolling, burns everything it passes and leaves a trail of fire.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.heat_absorb.desc: Draws fire and embers from the surroundings into his body: puts out fires, cools lava to obsidian, heals and fills the core heat for every source.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.fire_tornado.des: A vortex of flame at the target point that slowly follows your gaze, pulls enemies in and burns them for five seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.magma_eruption.d: The ground at the target point bursts open: three pillars of embers shoot up one after another, hurl enemies into the air and leave burning craters.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.meteor_rain.desc: Ultimate: for four seconds, glowing rocks rain down on the target area — every impact explodes, leaves a crater and sets everything on fire.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.blazing_rush.des: Combo: hit while sprinting. A glowing fist first — the target flies away burning with a tail of flame.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.comet_kick.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. A kick from above — the target crashes into the ground with an explosion.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ember_grip.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Grabs the target with a glowing hand, holds it in place and burns it for over a second.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.phoenix_dive.des: Combo: sneak high in the air. Dives as a fireball; the explosion, crater and fire ring grow with the height.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.incinerate.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Puts the whole core heat into one grip — heavy fire damage; if the target falls, it explodes and sets the enemies around it on fire.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.pyronite_core.de: Every power heats the core; fire, lava and the Nether heat it further, water cools it. Glowing (from half): +30% damage and a burning aura. Overheated: the next power discharges everything as blue fire with double damage.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.molten_touch.des: Every punch sets the target on fire for 4 seconds; while glowing, each punch also deals extra fire damage.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.heat_haze.desc: Projectiles burn up in the shimmering heat before they hit: 25% chance, up to 50% when overheated. Cold hurts a Pyronite more.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.fire_blast.desc: A fireball from the hand. Glowing: three at once; overheated: five exploding blue fireballs.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.fire_burst.desc: An explosion around the body: pushes enemies back, tears up the ground and sets the area on fire.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.flame_boost.desc: Leaps into the air and surfs on a column of fire, scorching everything below.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.inferno_wave.des: A wall of flame rolls forward in a cone and hits every target once when it reaches it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.flame_shield.des: A shell of fire: burns up projectiles nearby, sets attackers on fire and stores heat.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.supernova.desc: Ultimate: releases a blinding nova of fire and leaves a burning sun core that keeps scorching the area.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tail_whip.desc: A lightning-fast spin: the tail hits everything around him, throws it back and slows it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rapid_disarm.des: Races past every enemy nearby and takes their weapons — just like in the show, before anyone notices. Disarmed enemies are weakened.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.vacuum_trail.des: A straight sprint of up to 16 blocks: the vacuum behind XLR8 pulls enemies from both sides into the trail and spins them around, stunned.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.friction_fire.de: Runs in circles so fast that the ground ignites: a ring of fire with a radius of 4 blocks burns for four seconds.
Afterimages circle every enemy nearby and strike from all sides — blinded and confused, they barely know where XLR8 is.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mach_sprint.desc: Ultimate: three seconds at hypersonic speed — full sound barrier, invulnerable, everything in the way gets run over or smashed through. Ends with a sonic boom that knocks down everything around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.supersonic_shove: Combo: hit while sprinting. Impact with a sonic boom — the target flies far, the faster XLR8 is, the further.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.blitz_kick.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Two kicks in one spin — the target flies up and XLR8 bounces up with it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.leg_sweep.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Tail and leg sweep the target off its feet — it stays down, heavily slowed.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.speed_dive.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Dives diagonally forward; the impact releases a shockwave that grows with tempo.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.hundred_blows.de: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Ten hits in one second from every direction, the last one a sonic boom that sends the target flying.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.kineceleran_temp: Running and hits build tempo, standing still loses it. Blurred (from half): blue afterimages and extra damage per punch. Sound barrier: the next power uses all the tempo for its strongest form.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.blur_runner.desc: Blurred and sprinting, XLR8 runs over water and straight up walls. At the sound barrier, everything in the way is run over and walls are smashed through.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.quick_reflexes.d: While blurred, XLR8 simply dodges 20% of hits and projectiles.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.dash_strike.desc: A lightning dash forward that strikes everything along the way.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.blur_dodge.desc: Leaves an afterimage that draws enemies' attention while XLR8 is gone — briefly untouchable.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rapid_strikes.de: A flurry of fast blows on the target in front — the number grows with tempo; at the sound barrier it is hurled into the air.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cyclone_run.desc: Runs in circles around himself: the cyclone pulls enemies in, spins them and throws them out.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.time_slip.desc: For XLR8, time seems to stand still: enemies nearby move in slow motion while he stays fast.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.lightspeed_barra: Ultimate: races from enemy to enemy at light speed and strikes each one several times.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_lance.de: A row of crystal spikes bursts from the ground in your line of sight, one after another up to 14 blocks — every enemy in the way is thrown into the air.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_hammer.d: His arm becomes a crystal hammer: a strike from above in front of him — crater, flying shards, a crystal cluster and slowed enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_wall.des: A wall of crystal (5 wide, 3 high, topped with spikes) grows in front of Diamondhead and holds for 8 seconds — cover against projectiles and enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_cage.des: Encases the target you are looking at in crystal — it cannot move until the cage shatters.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.diamond_drill.de: Both arms become drills: a thrust about 10 blocks forward, straight through stone and enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_cathedra: Ultimate: three rings of giant crystals burst from the ground one after another, then shatter into a rain of shards on every enemy around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_ram.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. Shoulder first with crystal plates — the target flies far, shards spray.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shard_fall.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. A downward strike — a crystal spike bursts out beneath the target and throws it up.
Combo: hit while sneaking. Crystal grows over the target's feet — rooted in place for 2 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.diamond_drop.des: Combo: sneak high in the air. Dives down; on impact a wave of crystal spikes bursts out around him — stronger the higher the fall.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystallize.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Crystal overgrows the target and shatters — heavy damage, and the shards fly at the nearest enemies.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.petrosapien_reso: Projectiles bounce off and build resonance, as do damage dealt and taken. Faceted (from half): bouncing projectiles fly back at the shooter as crystal shards. Prism (full): the next power uses it all for its biggest form.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_regrowth: Petrosapiens grow back: four seconds without being hit, Diamondhead heals half a heart every second.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.diamond_hide.des: Punching diamond hurts: 20% less melee damage, and attackers often chip their fists on crystal (35% chance, 1.5 hearts).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_volley.d: Fires a volley of crystal shards from the hand.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_blade.de: His arm becomes a crystal blade: a wide slash in front of him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_vault.de: Crystal surfing: a crystal bridge grows under Diamondhead and follows his gaze — even uphill — and shatters behind him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spike_eruption.d: A ring of crystal spikes bursts out of the ground around him and spreads outwards.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_armor.de: A dome of crystal spikes protects him: melee attackers hurt themselves and resonance does not fade.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_storm.de: Ultimate: shards circle around Diamondhead, then fly outwards in every direction.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.head_hop.desc: Leaps onto the nearest enemy's head and hammers away for three seconds — the enemy staggers around confused, just like in the show.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.calculated_strik: A precisely calculated hit on the target you look at — ignores armour and grows with everything Grey Matter knows about the species.
A jury-rigged gadget flies to the target point and discharges after 1.5 seconds — electric blast, paralysed and marked enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mini_turret.desc: Builds a tiny turret in seconds that fires at the nearest enemy for 10 seconds — the more Grey Matter knows about it, the harder it hits.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.weakness_grid.de: Analyses every enemy nearby at once: knowledge +1 for each, marked for the party, glowing, and the next hit on each deals +150%.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.galvan_device.de: Ultimate: a singularity device pulls every enemy together for three seconds, analyses them and implodes — damage based on knowledge, all survivors weakened.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ankle_bite.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A bite into the ankle — the target bleeds (poison) and limps (slowed).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.skull_hop.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Lands on the head, two blows, and springs high for the next jump.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wire_trip.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Ties the target's legs together with wire — held in place for 2.5 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.precision_drop.d: Combo: sneak high in the air. A guided fall onto the nearest enemy below — damage grows with knowledge.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.logical_conclusi: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Grey Matter has calculated everything — damage based on the remaining health and knowledge; from knowledge 3, exactly as much as needed.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.keen_observer.de: Every punch marks the target for the party (everyone deals 20% more damage to it). Every victory teaches him something about the species (35% chance).
passive.kingdomomnitrix.tiny_target.desc: So small that a lot simply misses: 35% of projectiles and 20% of explosions do no damage.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.wall_crawler.des: Galvans climb: run against a wall to climb it, sneak to cling in place.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.scan.desc: Analyses the target: shows its stats, knowledge about the species +1 (permanent, bonus in every form), marked for the party.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.weak_spot.desc: Finds the weak spot: the next hit by any player deals 150% extra damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.scurry.desc: Scurries away at high speed, tiny and hard to hit.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tech_snare.desc: Places a tech trap: the first enemy to step on it is held in place.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.jury_rig.desc: Repairs your equipment with whatever is at hand.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mastermind.desc: Ultimate: for 10 seconds Grey Matter sees every attack coming and dodges every second one; everything around him is analysed.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crunch_bite.desc: The jaws snap shut: heavy damage, the target is weakened, bleeds and becomes the prey.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wall_leap.desc: A long bound; if he hits a wall he pushes off and leaps back — up to twice. Great for climbing and chasing.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.quill_carpet.des: Quills rain down all around him: anyone walking over them is hurt and slowed for 8 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.hunting_howl.des: A howl that smells out everything: all enemies nearby glow, the nearest becomes the prey, blood frenzy +2 and the party runs faster.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.drag_down.desc: Leaps onto the prey (or the nearest enemy), pins it to the ground for 3 seconds and mauls it — more damage with blood frenzy.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wild_hunt.desc: Ultimate: for 6 seconds Wildmutt leaps from enemy to enemy, bites each one, makes it bleed and heals with every bite.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tackle_pounce.de: Combo: hit while sprinting. Wildmutt throws his full weight at the target — knocked down, bleeding, and marked as prey.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.quill_dive.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. A rain of quills downward onto the target and everything around it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.throat_bite.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. A silent bite — the prey bleeds twice as long and is weakened.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.predator_drop.de: Combo: sneak high in the air. Drops onto the nearest enemy below and pins it to the ground.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rip_apart.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. A savage attack — heavy damage, heals 30% of it and puts Wildmutt into full blood frenzy.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.vulpimancer_hunt: The first hit marks the prey. Every hit on it builds blood frenzy (+damage) and makes it bleed. When the prey falls, Wildmutt heals, gets faster and immediately picks up the next scent.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.scent_sight.desc: Blind, but the nose sees everything: blindness and darkness have no effect, monsters nearby glow, invisible enemies are smelled out.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.survival_instinc: Cornered, the beast becomes dangerous: below 40% health Wildmutt gets faster and stronger.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.pounce.desc: A huge leap at the target — knocks it over and marks it as prey.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.quill_burst.desc: Shoots a volley of quills; more in blood frenzy, and if they hit the prey it bleeds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.feral_roar.desc: A wild roar: enemies nearby flee in fear, the nearest becomes the prey.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.savage_maul.desc: A flurry of claws and bites on the prey — the higher the blood frenzy, the harder.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.scent_track.desc: Picks up the scent: all enemies far around glow and the trail leads to the strongest.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.primal_rampage.d: Ultimate: blood frenzy full and locked, life steal on every hit, every kill roars the surroundings into flight.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.acid_drop.desc: Three lumps of acid fall below Stinkfly one after another and leave corrosive, sticky puddles — ideal from the air.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.stinger_strike.d: A thrust forward with the tail stinger, up to 6 blocks: strong poison, two toxin stacks and a slowed target.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slime_trap.desc: A glob of slime glues the target you look at to the spot for 3 seconds and leaves a sticky puddle.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.gas_jet.desc: A burst of gas shoots Stinkfly forward and leaves a trail of poison clouds behind.
A corrosive mist sprayed in a cone for one second: three toxin stacks on every target, weakening armour and strength.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.plague_cloud.des: Ultimate: a huge cloud of poison follows Stinkfly for 8 seconds — one toxin stack per second on everything inside, plus poison and nausea.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wing_slash.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. The edge of the wing cuts — knockback, a toxin stack and a swirl of gas.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.dive_sting.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. The stinger from above — strong poison and two toxin stacks.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slime_grab.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Slime from the mouth glues the target in place for 2 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.toxic_plunge.des: Combo: sneak high in the air (not while flying). Crashes down, and a big poison cloud bursts on impact.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.dissolve.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Uses up all of its toxin stacks — extra damage per stack, and the poison jumps to enemies nearby.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.lepidopterran_to: Every hit and every second in his clouds adds a toxin stack (up to 5). At 5: decomposition — withering, slowed, every hit by anyone deals 30% more. Badly poisoned targets burst when they die and infect their neighbours.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.compound_eyes.de: Four eyes see everything: blindness and darkness have no effect, and while flying Stinkfly dodges 30% of projectiles.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.stench.desc: A biting smell: anyone who comes too close gets nauseous and weak.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slime_spit.desc: Spits balls of slime; every hit adds a toxin stack.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.stink_cloud.desc: A dense cloud of poison gas spreads on the ground in front of him — a toxin stack per second for everyone inside.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wing_dash.desc: A dodge in the direction you look, leaving a trail of poison behind.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slime_bomb.desc: A slime bomb lands at the target point and bursts — three stacks around it and a sticky slime field.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.updraft.desc: A gust of wind throws enemies up and poisons them; Stinkfly glides down gently afterwards.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.toxic_storm.desc: Ultimate: a ring of clouds circles Stinkfly; at the end every stack around him discharges as damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.water_jet.desc: A high-pressure jet of water from the mouth: damage and knockback along the line, puts out fires and leaves a small tide zone at the end.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.geyser.desc: A geyser shoots Ripjaws into the air and throws enemies around him up as well — leaves a tide zone.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.feeding_frenzy.d: Six fast bites forward within two seconds; every bite that lands heals a little.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bubble_shield.de: A bubble of water surrounds Ripjaws for 6 seconds: counts as water, much less damage, and projectiles are slowed down inside it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.riptide_pull.des: A current drags every enemy within 10 blocks towards Ripjaws, slows them and leaves a tide zone around him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.maelstrom.desc: Ultimate: a giant whirlpool at the target point pulls, spins and hurts for 6 seconds, then ends in a flood wave.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shark_ram.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A headbutt with the whole body — the target flies far, twice as far when wet.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.jaw_dive.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. A bite from above that drags the target down.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.drag_under.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Drags the target under water — held in place while it runs out of air.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.splash_down.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Crashes down; the impact releases a flood wave and leaves a tide zone.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.death_bite.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. The jaws close for good — heavy damage and Ripjaws heals 40% of it.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.tidal_strength.d: Wet, Ripjaws hits harder: +25% damage in water, in the rain and in his own tide zones.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.deep_hunter.desc: Under water he is in his element: sees in the dark and slowly heals.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.blood_scent.desc: Like a shark: against targets below half health he deals 20% more damage and heals with every hit.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.jaw_bite.desc: A bite with combo: bites in quick succession get stronger; the third is the death roll — the target is spun around, pulled down and held.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tidal_dash.desc: A lunge forward; when wet it is three times as strong and breaks through walls.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.whirlpool.desc: A whirlpool around Ripjaws: slows and spins enemies, counts as water for him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tail_swipe.desc: A powerful swipe of the tail all around him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.hydro_heal.desc: Heals in a cool tide zone that also stops him from drying out.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tidal_wave.desc: Ultimate: a huge flood wave rolls forward and sweeps away everything in its path.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.stretch_grab.des: His arm shoots out up to 14 blocks: grabs a target and pulls it in (with nanites) — without a target it pulls Upgrade to the wall like a grappling hook.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.gear_upgrade.des: Briefly merges with the party's gear and upgrades it — 10 seconds of strength, speed and protection for everyone nearby.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.nano_drones.desc: Four drones circle Upgrade for 8 seconds and shoot lasers at the nearest enemy, injecting nanites.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.laser_grid.desc: A wall of laser beams in front of Upgrade for 6 seconds — anyone passing through takes damage, is slowed and gets nanites.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.emp_pulse.desc: A pulse with a radius of 8 paralyses enemies, destroys projectiles in flight and hits machines (golems) twice as hard.
Ultimate: instant overclock, then optic beams on every enemy around for 3 seconds — each one injects nanites.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.liquid_ram.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. Flows through the target as liquid — damage, two nanites, and he comes out behind it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.hammer_morph.des: Combo: hit in mid-air. His arm forms a hammer — a strike downward with a small crater.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.nanite_inject.de: Combo: hit while sneaking. Injects three nanites at once and paralyses the target.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.liquid_drop.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Falls as liquid and splashes — damage and nanites all around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.system_crash.des: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Discharges every nanite in it — damage per nanite and a chain lightning to its neighbours.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.mechamorph_integ: Hits, flowing through enemies and nearby tech raise integration; melee hits inject nanites. Linked (from half): beams and maces chain to more targets. Full: overclock — +40% damage and faster.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.self_repair.desc: A machine body: poison and wither do not work, and out of combat Upgrade slowly repairs himself.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.liquid_body.desc: Punches partly pass through his liquid body: 25% less melee damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.optic_beam.desc: A beam from the eye; linked it pierces everything in the line and jumps to two more targets.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.liquid_form.desc: Becomes liquid and flows through enemies, gaining integration with each one.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tech_upgrade.des: Techno fusion: merges with nearby technology and charges up integration.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mace_fists.desc: Morphs his fists into maces — melee hits discharge the nanites in the target.
Takes over a mob for a few seconds: it fights for Upgrade. Bosses and players get a system glitch instead.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.plasma_cannon.de: Ultimate: a plasma cannon forms from his body; when overclocked it becomes the Omega cannon.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.soul_drain.desc: A beam drains life from the target for 2 seconds — damage, healing and fear.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ghost_flight.des: Ghostfreak floats in the direction you look for 3 seconds — straight through walls and untouchable; afterwards his next melee hit is an ambush.
Chains of ectoplasm bind up to three enemies around the target point for 3 seconds — each one is struck with fear.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.vanish.desc: Invisible for 8 seconds — enemies lose track of him, and the next melee hit is an ambush with double damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.haunting.desc: Curses the target for 10 seconds: every second ghostly hands strike it, it is slowed and its fear keeps growing.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.phantom_legion.d: Ultimate: six phantoms circle the area for 6 seconds and attack every enemy — mass panic.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spectral_rush.de: Combo: hit while sprinting. Passes straight through the target — damage and double fear, and he comes out behind it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shadow_drop.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Grabs the target from above and slams it to the ground — fear.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.chilling_touch.d: Combo: hit while sneaking. An icy ghost hand — slows, weakens, double fear; from behind it deals double damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.haunt_crash.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Crashes down, and the impact strikes fear into everyone around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.soul_rend.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Tears out the soul — heavy damage (more against panicking targets); if it falls, Ghostfreak heals and his dread rises.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.ectonurite_dread: Enemies collect fear; at full fear they panic — they flee and take +30% damage from him. Dread grows with fear and hits. Eerie (from half): every melee hit spreads fear. After phasing, the next melee hit is an ambush with double damage.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.intangible.desc: Attacks often pass straight through him (25%). In sunlight — the Ectonurite weakness — only 10%, and he takes 15% more damage there.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.night_stalker.de: At night he deals 20% more damage, and sneaking in the dark he turns invisible.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tentacle_lash.de: A lash with the chest tentacles; when eerie it grabs up to three targets.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.phase_shift.desc: Becomes intangible and passes through walls and enemies; afterwards the next melee hit is an ambush.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.haunting_scare.d: A terrifying shriek: enemies nearby are filled with fear.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.possession.desc: Ghostfreak enters a mob, steers it against other enemies and drains it; then he bursts out. Bosses and players are paralysed and lifted instead.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shadow_step.desc: Steps through the shadows behind the target — ambush ready.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.nightmare.desc: Ultimate: a nightmare around Ghostfreak; with full dread it becomes a soul harvest — panicking victims are drained and every death heals him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bowling_strike.d: Rolls flat along the ground up to 20 blocks straight ahead — everyone hit flies up like a bowling pin.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wrecking_ball.de: Curls up and flies in an arc onto the target point — crater and shockwave on impact.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.pinball.desc: For 4 seconds the ball bounces back and forth through the area — off walls and enemies — hitting everything on its way.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spike_shell.desc: Spikes extend from the shell for 8 seconds — anyone who touches or hits Cannonbolt gets stabbed.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shell_spin.desc: Spins in place for 3 seconds — pulls enemies in, hits all around and sends projectiles back.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bounce_barrage.d: Ultimate: high into the air, then four bounces in the direction you look — every impact with crater, explosion and shockwave.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.curl_charge.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. Curls up mid-run and rams — the target flies far.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ball_stomp.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Drops onto the target as a ball — a short shockwave around it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shell_counter.de: Combo: hit while sneaking. Closes the shell mid-strike — the target bounces off and Cannonbolt is protected for 2 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cannon_drop.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Drops as a cannonball — crater and shockwave that grow with the height.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bullseye.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. A cannonball from point-blank range — huge damage, and the target flies away explosively.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.armored_shell.de: The shell catches projectiles (40% less damage) and explosions (30% less).
passive.kingdomomnitrix.rolling_momentum: With a run-up the shell hits harder: +20% damage while sprinting, and punches throw the target back.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.bounce_back.desc: Round like a ball: fall damage becomes a bounce with a small shockwave instead.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cannonball.desc: Rolls straight ahead as a cannonball, builds momentum, hits everything on the way and bounces off walls up to three times.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shell_guard.desc: Shell ball: much less damage, no knockback, projectiles fly back at the shooter and melee attackers are flung away.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ball_bounce.desc: A ball jump; the landing releases a shockwave.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ricochet.desc: Bounces back and forth between up to 4 enemies; every further hit is stronger, the last one hits with a shockwave.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rolling_mode.des: Rolling mode: a fast ball that climbs steps and rams enemies; every 2 seconds at full speed shifts up a gear.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cannonade.desc: Ultimate: high into the air, then a dive with a huge shockwave — the drop height increases the damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.neuro_volley.des: Five rapid neuroshock beams from the eyes within one second — each one charges the target up.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.dive_bomb.desc: Climbs briefly, then dives onto the target point — a neuroshock ring on impact.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sonic_barrier.de: Breaks the sound barrier — a cone of sonic boom hurls enemies away and leaves them dazed.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.barrel_roll.desc: An evasive roll to the side, briefly invulnerable — projectiles nearby bounce back at the shooter.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.static_field.des: Charges the air for 6 seconds — every second a spark jumps to every enemy nearby.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mach_ten.desc: Ultimate: races at supersonic speed through up to 6 enemies one after another — every pass hits and charges twice.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wing_cut.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. The wing edge cuts in passing — the target spins away to the side and gets charged.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sky_snatch.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Grabs the target and pulls it up with him — then lets it fall.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tail_sting.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. The tail tip strikes directly — neuroshock with a long paralysis.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.power_dive.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. A steep dive — a neuroshock explosion on impact that grows with the height.
Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Instant overload — the charge jumps over to everyone nearby.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.neuro_charge.des: Every neuroshock and every punch charges the target. At 3 charges it overloads: spark explosion, extra damage nearby, long paralysis.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.aerodynamics.des: In the air Jetray hits 20% harder and projectiles often only graze him (30% less damage).
passive.kingdomomnitrix.aerophibian.desc: At home in the water: regeneration and strength while swimming.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.neuroshock.desc: A neuroshock beam from the eyes straight ahead — paralyzes the target and charges it up.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tail_shock.desc: A tail lightning bolt that jumps across up to 3 enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.jet_burst.desc: A jet thrust in the direction you look (even upwards), briefly invulnerable; whoever is in the way is swept along.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.strafing_run.des: A low flight straight ahead that fires at enemies in range along the way.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slipstream.desc: Slipstream: much faster flight, and the group nearby gets faster too.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.neuroshock_storm: Ultimate: rises up and rains neuroshock on all enemies around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.frost_lance.desc: A focused ice beam — chills hard; a frozen target shatters at once.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.frost_ground.des: Freezes the ground at the target point — anyone standing on it cools down further every second.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wing_wrap.desc: Wraps himself in his wings for 4 seconds — much less damage, attackers freeze up; then a frost burst.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ice_spikes.desc: A row of ice spikes erupts from the ground in front of Big Chill — hits, lifts and chills.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.blizzard.desc: A snowstorm at the target point for 6 seconds — chills, blinds and tosses enemies around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ice_comet.desc: Ultimate: a huge chunk of ice crashes down on the target point — everyone in the impact freezes first, then the impact shatters them all at once.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cold_rush.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. Phases right through the target and reappears behind it — it freezes from the inside.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.icicle_drop.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. An icicle from above — the target is rammed to the ground and chilled.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.frost_grip.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Grabs the target with icy claws — holds it in place and chills it deeply.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.glacier_fall.des: Combo: sneak high in the air. A dive with a ring of ice on impact — stronger the higher he falls.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shatter_strike.d: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Freezes it in an instant and smashes it in the same moment.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.hypothermia.desc: Every direct hit chills the target. At 100 it freezes solid; a hard hit on a frozen target shatters it and chills its neighbours.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.frost_body.desc: Anyone who hits Big Chill in melee freezes up. Cold cannot hurt him and fire hurts 20% less.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.phantom_wings.de: Necrofriggian phasing: one in five hits or projectiles simply passes through him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ice_breath.desc: A cone of cold — chills hard, puts out fire and freezes water into melting frost ice.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ice_shards.desc: A spread of ice shards; frozen targets hit by them always shatter.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.phase_flight.des: Rushes forward dematerialized — everyone flown through is chilled hard.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ice_prison.desc: Encases the target in real ice blocks; it freezes at once, the ice melts afterwards.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cryo_cloak.desc: Invisible, projectiles pass through, the nearby air chills; then a frost burst.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.absolute_zero.de: Ultimate: everything around freezes instantly, water turns to ice, fire goes out — 2 seconds later all still frozen shatter together.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.boulder_toss.des: Rips a boulder out of the ground and throws it — impact with a shockwave, bigger with every growth stage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.primal_roar.desc: Enemies around become weak and back off, allies grow strong — and he grows a stage on the spot.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.belly_flop.desc: Leaps forward and slams into the ground with full weight — area damage depending on his size.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spike_plates.des: Bone plates rise for 10 seconds — armor, spikes stab attackers and he doesn't shrink.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.extinction.desc: Ultimate: grows to full size, leaps high and crashes down like a meteor — a huge crater and three quake waves.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.dino_charge.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. Rams with his whole body — the target flies far.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.hammer_drop.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Both fists from above — the target is driven into the ground, a small quake.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bear_hug.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Grabs the target and squeezes — three crushing hits, then lets go.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.quake_landing.de: Combo: sneak high in the air. Lands with full mass — a quake that grows with height and size.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.giant_toss.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Lifts the target over his head and hurls it high and far.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.vaxasaurian_grow: Dealing and (even more) taking damage makes him grow: three stages, each bigger, stronger and tougher. Out of combat he slowly shrinks.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.thick_hide.desc: A fixed part of every hit bounces off — more with every growth stage, at most half.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.earthshaker.desc: Full-strength punches shake the ground around the target and knock nearby enemies off their feet.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mega_punch.desc: Hold to charge: a punch with a shockwave in the direction you look — hits everything in line and smashes a tunnel through walls.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tail_sweep.desc: A tail sweep all around — hits and knocks back everyone nearby.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.stampede.desc: Charges forward like a stampede and tramples everything in the way.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tectonic_quake.d: A powerful stomp — the ground erupts in a wide circle and launches enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bone_guard.desc: Bone armor: much less damage, and melee attackers are thrown back and hurt.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.titanic_growth.d: Ultimate: instantly full size and beyond — every step shakes the ground.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.titan_clap.desc: Claps his huge hands together — a cone of pressure ahead, enemies fly and are dazed.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.seed_bombs.desc: Three seed pods — each one bursts into a gas cloud and ties up enemies there with vines.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.vine_whip.desc: A vine lashes out 9 blocks — hits everything on the line and yanks it closer.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.fire_wall.desc: A wall of methane right in front of him, ignited at once — burns for 5 seconds, whoever walks through burns too.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.thorn_bark.desc: Thorny bark covers him for 8 seconds — armor, and whoever touches him gets pricked.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.swamp_geyser.des: The swamp bursts open at the target point — hurls enemies up and leaves a gas cloud behind.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.jungle_wrath.des: Ultimate: giant vines burst out all around — they bind every enemy, stab every second and wrap each one in gas. After 3 seconds Swampfire ignites it all at once.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.flame_dash.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A burning shove — the target flies and stays on fire for a long time.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mud_slam.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. A mud fist from above — the target goes down, slowed and wrapped in gas.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.root_grab.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Roots grow from his fist and hold the target in place.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.swamp_crash.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Drops like a gas bomb — explodes on impact, stronger the higher he falls.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.combustion.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. The methane inside the target goes off — a huge burst of flame, clouds nearby ignite.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.burning_fists.de: Every punch sets the target on fire and ignites any gas around it — the spark for every chain reaction.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.methane_body.des: Explosions barely hurt him (60% less). Hard hits sometimes squeeze gas out of him — a cloud right where the attacker stands.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.photosynthesis.d: A plant being: on grass or earth, in rain or in water he slowly regenerates.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.methane_flame.de: A jet of fire where you look — hits the first creature, sets it on fire and ignites every cloud on the way.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.methane_cloud.de: Releases a methane cloud: on its own it only makes you sick — fire turns it into an explosion.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.methane_jet.desc: A methane jet propels him forward and leaves a trail of gas behind.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.root_snare.desc: Roots burst from the ground at the target point and hold enemies there tight while they stab.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.regrowth.desc: Heals at once and regenerates, removes harmful effects and makes plants around him grow.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.swamp_inferno.de: Ultimate: fills the area with gas and ignites it after a short moment — a huge swamp explosion.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.light_lance.desc: A piercing beam — hits everything in the line; up to 15 stored energy becomes bonus damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_spires.d: A ring of crystals bursts out around Chromastone — damage, and enemies are hurled upwards.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mirror_prism.des: A floating prism at the target point fires at the nearest enemy every second for 8 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.blinding_flash.d: A glaring cone of light — enemies are blind and weak for 5 seconds; everyone hit charges some energy.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.energy_release.d: All stored energy in one thick beam — the damage grows with the energy stored.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spectral_catacly: Ultimate: draws in all the light around for 2 seconds (store full), then a huge rainbow nova with a crystal ring — blinds, hurls away, massive damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.prism_rush.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A crystal shoulder charge — the hit refracts onto two enemies nearby.
Combo: hit in mid-air. A spear of light downwards — the target goes down, a small nova around it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.absorb_touch.des: Combo: hit while sneaking. Drains the target's energy — it slows down, Chromastone charges up a lot.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.meteor_prism.des: Combo: sneak high in the air. Plunges like a comet of light — a nova on impact, stronger the higher he falls.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spectrum_break.d: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. The full spectrum shatters inside the target — seven beams all around.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.solar_cells.desc: In direct sunlight his crystal body slowly fills the spectral store.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.crystal_resonanc: Every punch makes his crystal body ring and charges a little energy; with a store of 75% or more his punches hit 20% harder.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.refraction.desc: Even physical hits are partly broken into light — taking damage charges the store.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.prism_beam.desc: A rainbow beam onto the first target, which refracts it — partial beams jump to the nearest enemies; uses up to 30 stored energy for bonus damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spectral_burst.d: A glaring wave around Chromastone — blinds and pushes away; with 20 stored energy twice the force.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.photon_dash.desc: Leaps up to 10 blocks forward at the speed of light — whoever stands in the way gets hit.
For a short time every kind of damage is absorbed and stored, not just energy.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.solar_charge.des: Charges the store — a lot in bright light, less in the dark.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.full_spectrum.de: Ultimate: for 3 seconds rainbow beams hit every enemy in range.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sound_bullet.des: A focused shot from Echo Echo and every clone at the target in sight — many sources, lots of resonance.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.echo_swap.desc: Swaps places with the clone that stands most in the direction you look — a sonic bang at both spots.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.feedback_loop.de: The clones surround the target in sight and scream into it from all sides for 3 seconds — it can't get away.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bass_drop.desc: A deep tone into the ground — a wave around Echo Echo and every clone; enemies fly up and stagger.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.clone_burst.desc: All clones burst into sonic explosions — the more clones, the more devastating.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sonic_symphony.d: Ultimate: the full choir lines up in a circle around the target point and plays for 5 seconds — every half second every voice hits everything in the middle; it ends in a crescendo.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.echo_tackle.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A sonic shove — the target flies, and a new clone appears.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.drop_note.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. A sonic blast downwards — the target goes down, a small wave around it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.point_blank.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. A scream from point-blank range — hits twice (resonance) and leaves the target reeling.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.boom_landing.des: Combo: sneak high in the air. A dive with a sonic bang — all clones pulse at the same moment.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shatter_frequenc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. The target's own frequency — every clone screams along, each one makes it worse.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.sonorosian_reson: Every full punch hums: it counts as a sound source — punch plus scream means resonance.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.echolocation.des: Every 2 seconds a locating call: enemies nearby glow through walls.
Explosions and sonic attacks pass through his resonant body (half damage). Whoever hurts him gets screamed at by every clone.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sonic_scream.des: A cone of sound from Echo Echo and every clone at the target point — crossfire with resonance.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.echo_split.desc: New clones next to Echo Echo (at most 6 at a time); they draw monsters away and scream themselves.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sonic_boost.desc: A sonic blast launches Echo Echo where he looks; whatever stands behind him flies away.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wall_of_sound.de: All clones jump into a ring around Echo Echo and push sound waves outwards for 4 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sound_shield.des: Projectiles bounce off a wall of sound, no knockback.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.echo_chorus.desc: Ultimate: clones up to the maximum, then they all scream three times at everything around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.proton_volley.de: Three rapid proton shots at the target in sight, each one irradiates by one level.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.gamma_burst.desc: A cone of gamma rays — damage and +2 radiation for everyone in it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.atomic_barrier.d: An energy shell for 6 seconds — extra health, and projectiles decay at the shell.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.meltdown_zone.de: Irradiated ground at the target point — for 6 seconds, damage and radiation every second for everyone on it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.chain_reaction.d: Every irradiated target around splits at once — an explosion per level, and the radiation jumps on.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.fusion_sun.desc: Ultimate: a small sun above the target point burns for 6 seconds — pulls enemies in, burns and irradiates them every second; at the end it detonates.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.atom_smash.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A fist full of nuclear energy — the target flies and gets +2 radiation.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.fallout_strike.d: Combo: hit in mid-air. A blow from above — the target goes down, radiation in a small circle.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.isotope_grip.des: Combo: hit while sneaking. Pumps radiation into the target — +3 levels, and it turns weak.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.nuclear_dive.des: Combo: sneak high in the air. A dive with a nuclear explosion on impact — stronger the higher he falls.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.critical_mass.de: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Makes its core burst — damage per radiation level, and the fission jumps on.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.radioactive_touc: Every direct hit irradiates the target by one level. Radiation deals damage every second; targets with 2+ levels split on death and pass it on.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.reactor_core.des: The more irradiated the target, the harder Atomix hits: +10% damage per radiation level.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.radiation_shield: His core breaks down poison and wither at once; fire and explosions deal 30% less damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.atomic_bolt.desc: A green energy beam at the first target, +1 radiation (a fully irradiated target gets a small nuclear blast).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.nuclear_pulse.de: A pulse of nuclear energy around Atomix — damage and radiation for everyone nearby.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.fusion_leap.desc: A fusion-powered leap forward and up.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.containment_fiel: Locks the target in an energy field for a few seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.half_life.desc: Triggers all radiation around at once — damage per level, the radiation is used up.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.hero_time.desc: Ultimate: Atomix rises, gathers energy for 1.5 seconds — then a huge nuclear explosion (no block damage).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.claw_flurry.desc: Five quick claw slashes ahead — each one makes the target bleed.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.clothesline.desc: Charges 8 blocks with his arm stretched out — everyone in the way goes down.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.piledriver.desc: Grabs the target, leaps up and drives it head-first into the ground — a crater.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.elbow_drop.desc: A high jump and down elbow-first onto the target point — a shockwave on impact.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.trash_talk.desc: "LET ME TELL YOU SOMETHING!" — every monster nearby goes for Rath, and Rath takes much less damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.royal_rumble.des: Ultimate: 8 seconds of rampage — every second Rath grabs the nearest enemy and throws it behind him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spear_tackle.des: Combo: hit while sprinting. Rams the target down — it lies on the ground and can barely get up.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.flying_elbow.des: Combo: hit in mid-air. An elbow from above — the target goes down, a small impact around it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.headlock.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. Puts the target in a headlock — held for 3 seconds, damage every second.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.diving_splash.de: Combo: sneak high in the air. Flat onto everything below — the force grows with the drop height.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rath_bomb.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. A powerbomb — yanked over his head and smashed into the ground.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.unbreakable_fury: The less health, the harder he hits — up to +60% damage at 20% health.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.appoplexian_temp: Whoever hurts Rath only makes him angrier: hard hits give him strength for 4 seconds.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.victory_lap.desc: After every win: a short breather and on to the next — heals a little and gets faster.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.wrist_claw.desc: A quick stab with the wrist claw — bleeding (poison); against the rival twice as much.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.challenge.desc: Rath challenges an enemy as his rival: every third hit against it is a throw, and he takes 30% less damage from it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rath_charge.desc: A furious charge straight ahead that rams everything in the way.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.suplex.desc: Grabs the target and slams it into the ground behind him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.appoplexian_roar: A roar of fury: enemies around are weakened, Rath gets stronger.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rath_finale.desc: Ultimate: grabs the target, leaps high and finishes with a devastating slam.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_bola.desc: Three balls of web in a fan — wherever one lands, enemies stick.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_yank.desc: A web line to the target in sight — yanks it over to Spidermonkey and holds it briefly.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_wall.desc: Spins a wall of web across in front of him for 8 seconds — it stops anything that tries to get through.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.monkey_leap.desc: An acrobatic bound far forward and up — lands without fall damage and kicks when touching down.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_spinner.desc: Spins web all around — everyone nearby sticks and gets pulled a little closer.
Ultimate: web lines onto up to 6 enemies — they all stick. Then Spidermonkey leaps from one to the next and strikes with all four arms each time.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.swing_kick.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A kick on the run — the target flies and sticks briefly wherever it lands.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.spider_drop.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Drops onto the target from above and sticks it to the ground.
Combo: hit while sneaking. Four blows at once — one with each arm.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_crash.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Plunges down and splatters web on impact — everyone around sticks.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cocoon_slam.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Wraps the target in a cocoon, swings it around and smashes it to the ground.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.web_hunter.desc: Webbed targets are helpless: they take 50% more damage, and full punches against them hit with all four arms.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.monkey_climber.d: Running against a wall makes him climb it; sneaking holds on.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.spider_sense.des: He dodges some projectiles at the last moment (30% chance) and jumps aside.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_shot.desc: A web strand at the first target — holds it in place.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_net.desc: A wide net ahead — everyone caught in it sticks.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_swing.desc: A web line to any point in sight (wall, ceiling, ground) pulls him there.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.monkey_frenzy.de: A frenzy of blows with all four arms on everything in front of him.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_trap.desc: Lays a ring of web around him: whoever walks in — even later, for 10 seconds — gets stuck.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.web_cocoon.desc: Ultimate: every enemy around is spun into a cocoon and hoisted up — hanging helpless for 6 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cosmic_bolts.des: Three bursts of energy from his palms onto the target area; with 10 cosmic charge each, they hit harder.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ground_swipe.des: A giant hand sweeps the half-circle in front of Way Big — everything flies off to the side.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.skyward_uppercut: An uppercut — everything in front of Way Big flies high into the air.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.giant_grab.desc: Grabs the target in sight and holds it up in his fist for 2 seconds — then crushes it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cosmic_dome.desc: A dome of star energy for 5 seconds — allies inside are protected, projectiles burn up.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cosmic_cannon.de: Ultimate: 2 seconds of charging, then a gigantic cosmic beam that sweeps a 90-degree arc in front of Way Big within 2 seconds — it ploughs through the terrain and hits everything in its path.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.titan_kick.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. A kick that sends the target flying far — a small quake where he steps.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.sky_hammer.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Both fists from above — the target is driven into the ground, a quake all around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.giant_flick.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. A flick of the finger — the target flies off in a high arc.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.colossus_drop.de: Combo: sneak high in the air. The giant falls — a quake and crater depending on the drop height.
Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. A cosmic ray from point-blank range — uses up cosmic charge for extra damage.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.cosmic_charge.de: Cosmic energy gathers on its own (5 per second) and with every hit; the Cosmic Ray and other powers spend it for damage. When full, Way Big crackles blue.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.titan_step.desc: Every step shakes the ground — small enemies nearby stagger, soft ground gives way.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.tokustar_hide.de: Close-range attacks barely scratch his hide: 25% less melee damage.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.cosmic_ray.desc: Hold to charge: the cosmic ray from his arms — spends cosmic charge for damage and width.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.titan_stomp.desc: A quake around Way Big that hurls enemies upwards.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.giant_leap.desc: A mighty leap; the landing shakes the ground in a wide circle.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shockwave_clap.d: The shockwave of two giant hands — a cone with enormous knockback.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.tokustar_guard.d: To'kustar armour: hardly any damage, no knockback, melee attackers bounce off.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.starfall.desc: Ultimate: eight cosmic impacts in the area, one after another.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.star_lance.desc: Bellicus: a lance of starlight falls from the sky onto the target point.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.reality_anchor.d: Serena: every enemy around is written into place — no movement for 3 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.void_rift.desc: Bellicus: a rift in space at the target point pulls everything in for 3 seconds — then it implodes.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.rewind.desc: Serena: Alien X returns to where he was 3 seconds ago — with the health he had then, if that was more.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.constellation.de: Bellicus: links up to 5 enemies into a constellation — each one is hit, glows and slows down.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.genesis.desc: Ultimate (Serena): a piece of new reality around Alien X for 8 seconds — allies inside regenerate and are protected, enemies slow and weak; at the end it fully heals all allies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.comet_strike.des: Combo: hit while sprinting. A blow with a tail of stars — the target flies far.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.gravity_slam.des: Combo: hit in mid-air. Doubles the target's gravity — it crashes to the ground.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.stasis_touch.des: Combo: hit while sneaking. Stops the target's time — motionless for 2 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.starfall_dive.de: Combo: sneak high in the air. Falls like a star — an impact depending on the drop height.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.erase.desc: Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Writes the target out of reality — damage based on its missing health.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.celestial_harmon: The more the voices agree, the harder every hit lands: +10% damage per level of harmony.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.celestialsapien_: Magic and explosions from this universe barely touch him: 40% less damage.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.serenas_grace.de: If Alien X falls below 30% health, Serena steps in and restores 30% of it — once a minute.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.reality_bolt.des: Bellicus: a tear in space along the line of sight.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.gravity_warp.des: Bellicus: lifts everything around and slams it back down.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.blink.desc: Serena: instantly to the point in sight (up to 32 blocks, twice as far in omnipotence).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.time_stop.desc: Serena: everything around freezes for 5 seconds, projectiles hang in the air.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.creation.desc: Serena: fully heals Alien X and his group and removes harmful effects.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.big_bang.desc: Ultimate (Bellicus): a new universe in miniature — everything around is hit, then silence.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.electro_whip.des: A whip of lightning 10 blocks straight ahead — hits everything on the line and paralyzes briefly.
Jumps from the nearest enemy to up to four more — even without analysis.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.telekinetic_lift: Lifts the target in sight in an electric field, holds it for 3 seconds and lets it drop.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.ball_lightning.d: A slow ball of lightning rolls straight ahead for 4 seconds and strikes everything near it.
Analyzes every enemy around; allies get the plan — strength and haste for 10 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.thunderdome.desc: Ultimate: an electric dome around Brainstorm for 6 seconds — whoever tries to leave is pushed back; every second it strikes all enemies inside and analyzes them. At the end the dome discharges.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.shell_ram.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. Rams with his shell — plus an electric shock.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.skull_crack.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. A headbutt with the brain shell from above — the target is analyzed and knocked to the ground.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.pincer_grip.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. The pincers grab — held for 2 seconds, an electric jolt every half second.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.thunder_drop.des: Combo: sneak high in the air. Plunges down and discharges into everyone around on impact.
Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. A bolt straight into the nervous system — it jumps to every analyzed enemy.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.superior_intelle: One look is enough: whoever Brainstorm punches is analyzed for 5 seconds, and he hits analyzed targets 20% harder.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.crab_shell.desc: The crab shell keeps out projectiles (40% less damage) and blows (15% less).
passive.kingdomomnitrix.static_discharge: Whoever hits him in melee gets a shock — which jumps on to analyzed enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.lightning_arc.de: A bolt from his brain at the target in sight — jumps on over analyzed enemies.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.static_grid.desc: A static field at the target point — a bolt every second into everything inside (5 seconds).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.electro_levitati: Brainstorm floats for a few seconds on electric levitation.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.force_field.desc: For 5 seconds every hit is absorbed and charges his next bolt.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.brain_analysis.d: Every enemy in view is analyzed for 15 seconds: it glows, takes 30% more damage from everyone and passes on lightning.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.mind_storm.desc: Ultimate: for 4 seconds bolts of lightning strike enemies all around (real lightning visuals, no fire).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.acid_volley.desc: Four lumps of acid in an arc — wherever they land, it burns.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.goo_trap.desc: Sticky slime at the target point for 6 seconds — whoever stands in it can barely move and slowly corrodes.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slime_spikes.des: Goop forms spikes in every direction — hits and acid all around.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.bounce_blob.desc: Turns into a rubber ball — a huge bound, and the landing splashes acid all around.
Goop re-forms himself — heals 30%, removes harmful effects and splashes acid while doing it.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.acid_tsunami.des: Ultimate: a wave of acid rolls 20 blocks forward — it sweeps everything along and corrodes it (+3 acid).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slime_slide.desc: Combo: hit while sprinting. Slides right through the target — +2 acid, and it is knocked off its feet.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.goo_drop.desc: Combo: hit in mid-air. Lands on the target's head — it can't see a thing and corrodes.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.acid_grip.desc: Combo: hit while sneaking. His hand melts around the target — +3 acid in one go.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.splat.desc: Combo: sneak high in the air. Smacks down flat — acid splashes around depending on the drop height.
Combo: hit an enemy below 30% health. Uses up all the acid in the target — damage per level, splashes all around.
Every direct hit leaves acid (up to 5 levels): damage every second per level, and it eats the armour (weakness).
passive.kingdomomnitrix.slime_body.desc: Blows sink into the slime and lose force (20% less melee damage); whoever punches Goop gets acid on their hands.
passive.kingdomomnitrix.anti_gravity_pro: The projector carries him: higher jumps, and while sneaking in the air he drifts down slowly.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.acid_spit.desc: A jet of slime at the first target, +2 acid.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.slime_whip.desc: His arm stretches out to the target and pulls it in (+1 acid).
ability.kingdomomnitrix.puddle_form.desc: Flat, fast and invulnerable; whoever he flows through gets acid.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.engulf.desc: Goop engulfs the target — held tight, acid every second, for 4 seconds.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.acid_pool.desc: A pool at the target point for 8 seconds — whoever stands in it dissolves.
ability.kingdomomnitrix.acid_flood.desc: Ultimate: Goop melts into a huge pool around himself — everything in it gets full acid.
item.kingdomomnitrix.raw_corrodium.toolt: Toxic. Found only in the End.

book.kingdomomnitrix.plumber_log.captain:
Plumber cruiser PROCTOR
Captain Kaari

Day 1: Orders from Magister Tennyson. Bring two sealed pods from Galvan Prime to Earth. Code: O-10. Nobody on board opens them.
Day 3: Azmuth took the device apart himself. The Omnitrix up front in the lab, the console aft in engineering. Apart they are useless. Together … we don't talk about that.
Day 4: Unknown drones on our tail. A crest on their armour: a squid. Vilgax knows what we carry.
Day 4, later: hit in the drive. We are going down. Whoever finds this: get the pods to safety before Vilgax takes them.
book.kingdomomnitrix.plumber_log.enginee: Reactor overloaded. We are losing altitude over a class ‘Earth’ planet. I'll hold the field as long as I can.
For whoever reads this: shell and console belong in an Omnitrix Workbench. Its field needs Corrodium – the toxic green ore from the End – and four stabilizers.

Without an energy core the device won't start. A dye in the core colours it – Azmuth thought that was silly.

Don't give it to Vilgax.
– Rylla
